primary.title: This Bear Didn’t Need the Door
primary.description:
He didn't open the door. The window was enough.

Real public-domain NPS footage from Yosemite shows a bear at a car window. The real question is why a car can become worth checking again: one food reward can teach a search-and-repeat shortcut.

Secure food and lock vehicles in bear country.

Food conditioning is explained here as a general possibility, not a claim about this individual bear's history. No handle opening, food reward or native camera audio is shown or implied.

Footage: Bears in Cars — National Park Service (public domain).
Music: Emotional Spiritual Soundtrack - Respect — MusicByMisterbates (CC0).
Ambience: Forest Night Ambience — neverak (CC0).
SFX: Alex_hears_things and Rizzard (CC0).
Narration: AI-generated English voice.
Original Monarch Cam vertical edit and learning-loop animation.
